title: Deal ... Or No Deal
summary:
A year after sanctions are lifted, uncertainty has increased
One year ago, the United Nations lifted its sanctions against Iran after the International Atomic Energy Agency verified that Iran complied with certain key requirements. decision, Iran started to grow its crude oil production and exports. While not everything is back to "normal", Iran has once again become an important player in the oil and tanker markets.
